name: preserve script execution for group members in the shared area
definition: ensure the ACL mask still allows members to execute scripts stored in the shared directory.
failure_mode: a mask that strips execute blocks script execution

name: prevent queued-not-started tasks from running after cancellation
definition: When multiple tasks are queued and execution is interrupted, only tasks already started may begin; the unscheduled remainder must not start.
failure_mode: A gather/universal pattern leaks queued tasks into execution on cancellation.
